objective: Explain why actual KIS sidecar shadow performance does not transfer to historical proxy training, and define the next real-data backfill path.

decision.next_best_action: Backfill actual KIS sidecar-equivalent flow, financial, stock static, rank/VI, and news fields for more historical days before retraining.
